gamerule.leveldoessomething.levelPowerCu: The mathematical curve used to calculate attribute scaling. 0 = Exponential Tier steps, 1 = Smooth Logarithmic curve, 2 = Simple Linear scaling. Default: 1.
gamerule.leveldoessomething.levelPowerBa: The base multiplier applied per level in basis points (1/10000). A value of 10 represents 0.001 (0.1% increase). Default: 10.
gamerule.leveldoessomething.levelPowerMa: The maximum tier multiplier allowed when using the exponential tier system. Default: 10.
gamerule.leveldoessomething.levelPowerEn: When true, players at or above level 30 will spawn ambient experience-themed particles visible to all surrounding players. Default: true.
When true, experience collection sounds will be pitch-shifted higher as the player's level increases, providing auditory feedback. Default: true.
text.leveldoessomething.config.title: Level Does Something Config
text.leveldoessomething.config.option.en: If set to false, disables rendering of all level-based experience aura particles locally, improving client performance.
If set to false, disables client-side pitch shifting of experience collection sounds.
modmenu.description.leveldoessomething: Rewards players for accumulating experience levels by granting passive attribute boosts and ambient visual/sound feedback.
